recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31610 unless a future work group decision changes the resource contention or conditional patch semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-31610 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR Infrastructure technical correction for the RESTful API HTTP page. It asked that the PATCH paragraph stop describing If-Match/version-aware PATCH behavior as "conditional PATCH" and instead refer to the same Concurrency Management process defined for UPDATE.
initial_application: Commit 639dbcd2848776be444488fe66b23438c581256d explicitly listed FHIR-31610 and changed source/http.html from "servers SHALL support conditional PATCH" for the PATCH paragraph to Concurrency Management wording. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-31610 was found on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: publish.ini includes http.html in the active [pages] list, so source/http.html is build-scope source. Later source history kept the semantic split: the versionaware/resource contention section explains ETag and If-Match, the PATCH paragraph requires Resource Contention on PATCH, and the separate Conditional patch section describes a search URL that resolves one logical id. FHIR-17256, FHIR-34278, and FHIR-49646 are related history that support the current distinction and scoped wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current page no longer calls version-aware PATCH or If-Match support "conditional PATCH", and conditional patch is separately defined as search-based.
